**1999** ([MCMXCIX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_numerals "Roman numerals")) was a [common year starting on Friday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_year_starting_on_Friday "Common year starting on Friday") of the [Gregorian calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregorian_calendar "Gregorian calendar"), the 1999th year of the [Common Era](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_Era "Common Era") (CE) and _[Anno Domini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anno\_Domini "Anno Domini")_ (AD) designations, the 999th year of the [2nd millennium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2nd_millennium "2nd millennium"), the 99th year of the [20th century](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/20th_century "20th century"), and the 10th and last year of the [1990s](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990s "1990s") decade.

Calendar year

1999 was designated as the [International Year of Older Persons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Year_of_Older_Persons "International Year of Older Persons").

## Events

### January

*   [January 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_1 "January 1") – The [euro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euro "Euro") currency is established, and the [European Central Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/European_Central_Bank "European Central Bank") assumes full powers.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-1)
*   [January 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_3 "January 3") – The [Mars Polar Lander](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mars_Polar_Lander "Mars Polar Lander") is launched by [NASA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA "NASA").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-2)
*   [January 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_10 "January 10") – American crime drama series _[The Sopranos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Sopranos "The Sopranos")_ premieres on [HBO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HBO "HBO"), beginning what many commentators describe as the second “[Golden Age of Television](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Age_of_Television_(2000s%E2%80%932023) "Golden Age of Television (2000s–2023)")”.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-3)
*   [January 25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_25 "January 25") – The 6.2 M w[Colombia earthquake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Colombia_earthquake "1999 Colombia earthquake") strikes western [Colombia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colombia "Colombia"), killing at least 1,900 people.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-4)

### February

*   [February 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_7 "February 7")–[Abdullah II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abdullah_II_of_Jordan "Abdullah II of Jordan") inherits the throne of [Jordan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jordan "Jordan"), following the death of his father, King [Hussein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hussein_of_Jordan "Hussein of Jordan").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-5)
*   [February 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_11 "February 11")–[Pluto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pluto "Pluto") moves along its eccentric orbit further from the Sun than [Neptune](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neptune "Neptune"). It had been nearer than Neptune since [1979](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1979 "1979"), and will become again in [2231](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/23rd_century "23rd century").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-6)
*   [February 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_12 "February 12")– U.S. President [Bill Clinton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bill_Clinton "Bill Clinton") is acquitted in [impeachment proceedings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeachment_of_Bill_Clinton "Impeachment of Bill Clinton") in the [United States Senate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Senate "United States Senate").[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-7)
*   [February 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_16 "February 16")
    *   In [Uzbekistan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uzbekistan "Uzbekistan"), an apparent [assassination attempt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Tashkent_bombings "1999 Tashkent bombings") against President [Islam Karimov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam_Karimov "Islam Karimov") takes place at government headquarters.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-8)
    *   Across Europe, [Kurdish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kurds "Kurds") protestors take over embassies and hold hostages after [Turkey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkey "Turkey") arrests one of their rebel leaders, [Abdullah Öcalan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abdullah_%C3%96calan "Abdullah Öcalan").

*   [February 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_23 "February 23")
    *   [Kurdish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kurds "Kurds") rebel leader [Abdullah Öcalan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abdullah_%C3%96calan "Abdullah Öcalan") is charged with [treason](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Treason "Treason") in [Ankara](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ankara "Ankara"), Turkey.
    *   [1999 Galtür avalanche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Galt%C3%BCr_avalanche "1999 Galtür avalanche"): An [avalanche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avalanche "Avalanche") destroys the village of [Galtür](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galt%C3%BCr "Galtür"), Austria, killing 31.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-9)

*   [February 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_27 "February 27")– While trying to circumnavigate the world in a [hot air balloon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hot_air_balloon "Hot air balloon"), Colin Prescot and Andy Elson set a new endurance record after being aloft for 233 hours and 55 minutes.

### March

*   [March 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_1 "March 1")
    *   One of four bombs detonated in [Lusaka](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lusaka "Lusaka"), [Zambia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zambia "Zambia"), which destroys the [Angolan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angola "Angola") Embassy.
    *   [Rwandan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rwanda "Rwanda")[Hutu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hutu "Hutu") rebels kill and dismember eight foreign tourists at the Buhoma homestead, [Uganda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uganda "Uganda").
    *   The [Ottawa Treaty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ottawa_Treaty "Ottawa Treaty") comes into force.

*   [March 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_12 "March 12")– Former [Warsaw Pact](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warsaw_Pact "Warsaw Pact") members [Hungary](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hungary "Hungary"), [Poland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poland "Poland"), and the [Czech Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Czech_Republic "Czech Republic") join [NATO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO "NATO").
*   [March 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_15 "March 15")– The [Santer Commission](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Santer_Commission "Santer Commission") of the EU resigns over allegations of corruption.
*   [March 21](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_21 "March 21")
    *   [Bertrand Piccard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bertrand_Piccard "Bertrand Piccard") and [Brian Jones](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brian_Jones_(aeronaut) "Brian Jones (aeronaut)") become the first to circumnavigate the Earth in a [hot air balloon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hot_air_balloon "Hot air balloon").
    *   The [71st Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/71st_Academy_Awards "71st Academy Awards") are held at the [Dorothy Chandler Pavilion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dorothy_Chandler_Pavilion "Dorothy Chandler Pavilion") in [Los Angeles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles "Los Angeles") with _[Shakespeare in Love](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shakespeare\_in\_Love "Shakespeare in Love")_ winning [Best Picture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Picture "Academy Award for Best Picture").

*   [March 24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_24 "March 24")
    *   [NATO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO "NATO") launches [air strikes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO_bombing_of_Yugoslavia "NATO bombing of Yugoslavia") against the [Federal Republic of Yugoslavia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serbia_and_Montenegro "Serbia and Montenegro"), marking the first time NATO has attacked a sovereign state.
    *   A [fire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mont_Blanc_Tunnel_fire "Mont Blanc Tunnel fire") in the [Mont Blanc Tunnel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mont_Blanc_Tunnel "Mont Blanc Tunnel") kills 39 people, closing the tunnel for nearly three years.

*   [March 26](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_26 "March 26")– The [Melissa virus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melissa_(computer_virus) "Melissa (computer virus)") attacks the Internet.
*   [March 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_27 "March 27")–[Kosovo War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo_War "Kosovo War"): A U.S. [Lockheed F-117 Nighthawk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lockheed_F-117_Nighthawk "Lockheed F-117 Nighthawk") is shot down by Yugoslav forces.
*   [March 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_28 "March 28")– The adult animated sitcom _[Futurama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Futurama "Futurama")_ premiered on [Fox](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fox_Broadcasting_Company "Fox Broadcasting Company").
*   [March 29](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_29 "March 29")– For the first time, the [Dow Jones Industrial Average](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dow_Jones_Industrial_Average "Dow Jones Industrial Average") closes above the 10,000 mark, at 10,006.78.

### April

*   [April 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1 "April 1")–[Nunavut](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nunavut "Nunavut"), an [Inuit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inuit "Inuit") homeland, is created from the eastern portion of the [Northwest Territories](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northwest_Territories "Northwest Territories") to become Canada's third [territory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Provinces_and_territories_of_Canada "Provinces and territories of Canada").
*   [April 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_5 "April 5")
    *   Two [Libyans](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Libyan_Arab_Jamahiriya "Libyan Arab Jamahiriya") suspected of bringing down [Pan Am Flight 103](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pan_Am_Flight_103 "Pan Am Flight 103") in 1988 are handed over to Scottish authorities for eventual trial in the Netherlands. The [United Nations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations "United Nations") suspends sanctions against Libya.
    *   In [Laramie, Wyoming](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laramie,_Wyoming "Laramie, Wyoming"), Russell Henderson pleads guilty to [kidnapping](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kidnapping "Kidnapping") and felony murder, in order to avoid a possible [death penalty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital_punishment "Capital punishment") conviction for the apparent [hate crime](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hate_crime "Hate crime") killing of [Matthew Shepard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matthew_Shepard "Matthew Shepard").

*   [April 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_7 "April 7")–[Kosovo War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo_War "Kosovo War"): [Kosovo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo "Kosovo")'s main border crossings are closed by Yugoslav forces to prevent [Kosovo Albanians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo_Albanians "Kosovo Albanians") from leaving.
*   [April 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_9 "April 9")–[Ibrahim Baré Maïnassara](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibrahim_Bar%C3%A9_Ma%C3%AFnassara "Ibrahim Baré Maïnassara"), president of [Niger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Niger "Niger"), is assassinated.
*   [April 14](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_14 "April 14")–[Kosovo War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo_War "Kosovo War"): NATO warplanes repeatedly [bomb ethnic Albanian refugee convoys](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO_bombing_of_Albanian_refugees_near_Gjakova "NATO bombing of Albanian refugees near Gjakova") for 2 hours over a 12-mile stretch of road, after mistaking them for Yugoslav military trucks, between [Đakovica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%90akovica "Đakovica") and [Dečani](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/De%C4%8Dani "Dečani") in western Kosovo, killing at least 73 refugees.
*   [April 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_20 "April 20")–[Columbine High School massacre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbine_High_School_massacre "Columbine High School massacre"): 14 people, including 13 students[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-10) and one teacher, are killed in a [mass shooting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mass_shooting "Mass shooting") and attempted [bombing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bomb "Bomb") at a [high school](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbine_High_School "Columbine High School") in [Columbine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbine,_Colorado "Columbine, Colorado"), Colorado; 23 others are injured by the [two student perpetrators](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eric_Harris_and_Dylan_Klebold "Eric Harris and Dylan Klebold"), who then kill themselves.
*   [April 26](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_26 "April 26")
    *   Sultan [Salahuddin of Selangor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salahuddin_of_Selangor "Salahuddin of Selangor") becomes the 11th [Yang di-Pertuan Agong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yang_di-Pertuan_Agong "Yang di-Pertuan Agong") of [Malaysia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysia "Malaysia").
    *   British TV presenter [Jill Dando](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jill_Dando "Jill Dando"), 37, is shot dead on the doorstep of her home in [Fulham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fulham "Fulham"), London.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-Dando-11)

*   [April 30](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_30 "April 30")–[Cambodia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cambodia "Cambodia") joins the [Association of Southeast Asian Nations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Association_of_Southeast_Asian_Nations "Association of Southeast Asian Nations") (ASEAN), bringing the total members to 10.

### May

*   [May 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_1 "May 1") – Children's animated television series _[SpongeBob SquarePants](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SpongeBob\_SquarePants "SpongeBob SquarePants")_ premieres on [Nickelodeon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nickelodeon "Nickelodeon").[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-12)
*   [May 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_3 "May 3")–[1999 Oklahoma tornado outbreak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Oklahoma_tornado_outbreak "1999 Oklahoma tornado outbreak"): a [devastating tornado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Bridge_Creek%E2%80%93Moore_tornado "1999 Bridge Creek–Moore tornado"), rated F5 on the [Fujita scale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fujita_scale "Fujita scale"), hits southern and eastern [Oklahoma City metropolitan area](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oklahoma_City_metropolitan_area "Oklahoma City metropolitan area"), killing 36 people (and 5 indirectly) and producing the highest winds recorded on Earth: 301±20 mph (484±32 km/h).[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-13)
*   [May 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_7 "May 7")
    *   [Kosovo War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo_War "Kosovo War"): in the [Federal Republic of Yugoslavia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serbia_and_Montenegro "Serbia and Montenegro"), [three Chinese embassy workers are killed and 20 others wounded](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_bombing_of_the_Chinese_embassy_in_Belgrade "United States bombing of the Chinese embassy in Belgrade") when a [NATO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO "NATO")[B-2 aircraft](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northrop_B-2_Spirit "Northrop B-2 Spirit") bombs the Chinese Embassy in [Belgrade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgrade "Belgrade").
    *   In [Guinea-Bissau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guinea-Bissau "Guinea-Bissau"), President [João Bernardo Vieira](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jo%C3%A3o_Bernardo_Vieira "João Bernardo Vieira") is ousted in a military [coup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coup "Coup").

*   [May 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_9 "May 9")–[Mother's Day bus crash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mother's_Day_bus_crash "Mother's Day bus crash"): a charter bus veers off the roadway before colliding with a dirk embankment in [New Orleans, Louisiana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Orleans "New Orleans"), United States, killing 22 passengers and injuring another 22.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-14)
*   [May 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_12 "May 12")–[David Steel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Steel "David Steel") becomes the first Presiding Officer (Speaker) of the modern [Scottish Parliament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scottish_Parliament "Scottish Parliament").
*   [May 13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_13 "May 13")–[Carlo Azeglio Ciampi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carlo_Azeglio_Ciampi "Carlo Azeglio Ciampi") is elected President of Italy.
*   [May 14](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_14 "May 14")–[June 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_20 "June 20") – The [1999 Cricket World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Cricket_World_Cup "1999 Cricket World Cup") is held in England, (some matches in Scotland, Ireland, Wales and the Netherlands), with Australia defeating Pakistan in the final.
*   [May 17](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_17 "May 17")–[Ehud Barak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ehud_Barak "Ehud Barak") is [elected](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Israeli_general_election "1999 Israeli general election") prime minister of [Israel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel "Israel").
*   [May 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_23 "May 23") – The WWF pay-per-view event _[Over the Edge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Over\_the\_Edge\_(1999) "Over the Edge (1999)")_ takes place at [Kemper Arena](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kemper_Arena "Kemper Arena") in Kansas City, Missouri. The event is tragically remembered for the accidental death of wrestler [Owen Hart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Owen_Hart "Owen Hart") during a stunt.
*   [May 26](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_26 "May 26")
    *   [Kargil War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kargil_War "Kargil War"): The [Indian Air Force](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Air_Force "Indian Air Force") launches an attack on intruding [Pakistan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan") Army troops and [mujahideen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mujahideen "Mujahideen") militants in [Kashmir](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kashmir "Kashmir").
    *   The [1999 UEFA Champions League final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_UEFA_Champions_League_final "1999 UEFA Champions League final") takes place at the [Camp Nou](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camp_Nou "Camp Nou") Stadium, [Barcelona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barcelona "Barcelona"), in which the English side [Manchester United](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manchester_United_F.C. "Manchester United F.C.") defeats the German side [Bayern Munich](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Bayern_Munich "FC Bayern Munich") 2–1.

*   [May 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_27 "May 27")
    *   The [International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Criminal_Tribunal_for_the_former_Yugoslavia "International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia") in [The Hague, Netherlands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Hague "The Hague") indicts [Slobodan Milošević](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slobodan_Milo%C5%A1evi%C4%87 "Slobodan Milošević") and four others for [war crimes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/War_crime "War crime") and [crimes against humanity](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crimes_against_humanity "Crimes against humanity") committed in [Kosovo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo "Kosovo").
    *   [Space Shuttle _Discovery_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Space_Shuttle_Discovery "Space Shuttle Discovery") is launched on [STS-96](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/STS-96 "STS-96"), the first shuttle mission to dock with the [International Space Station](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Space_Station "International Space Station").[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-mission_page-15)

*   [May 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_28 "May 28")
    *   Two Swedish police officers are wounded by bank robbers armed with automatic firearms, and [later executed with their own service pistols](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malexander_murders "Malexander murders") in [Malexander](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malexander "Malexander"), [Sweden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sweden "Sweden").
    *   After 22 years of restoration work, [Leonardo da Vinci](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonardo_da_Vinci "Leonardo da Vinci")'s _[The Last Supper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Last\_Supper\_(Leonardo) "The Last Supper (Leonardo)")_ is placed back on display in [Milan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milan "Milan"), Italy.

*   [May 29](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_29 "May 29")–[Nigeria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nigeria "Nigeria") terminates military rule, and the [Fourth Nigerian Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fourth_Nigerian_Republic "Fourth Nigerian Republic") is established with [Olusegun Obasanjo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olusegun_Obasanjo "Olusegun Obasanjo") as [president](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Nigeria "President of Nigeria").

### June

*   [June 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_1 "June 1")
    *   [Napster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Napster "Napster"), a music downloading service, is created; it would later inspire other [file-sharing sites](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer-to-peer_file_sharing "Peer-to-peer file sharing") such as [The Pirate Bay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pirate_Bay "The Pirate Bay"), [LimeWire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LimeWire "LimeWire"), [Gnutella](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gnutella "Gnutella"), [Kazaa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kazaa "Kazaa"), [Morpheus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morpheus_(file-sharing_software) "Morpheus (file-sharing software)"), [BearShare](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BearShare "BearShare"), and [ΜTorrent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CE%9CTorrent "ΜTorrent") 1999–2010 period which some called the "Second [Golden Age of Piracy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Age_of_Piracy "Golden Age of Piracy")".[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-16)
    *   [American Airlines Flight 1420](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Airlines_Flight_1420 "American Airlines Flight 1420") crash lands after overrunning the runway at [Little Rock National Airport](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clinton_National_Airport "Clinton National Airport"), killing 11 of the 145 people on board.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-NTSB_AA1420-17):12

*   [June 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_2 "June 2") – The [King of Bhutan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jigme_Singye_Wangchuck "Jigme Singye Wangchuck") allows [television](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mass_media_in_Bhutan#Radio_and_television "Mass media in Bhutan") transmissions to commence in [the Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhutan "Bhutan") for the first time, coinciding with the King's Silver Jubilee.
*   [June 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_5 "June 5") – The [Islamic Salvation Army](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Salvation_Army "Islamic Salvation Army"), the armed wing of the [Islamic Salvation Front](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Salvation_Front "Islamic Salvation Front"), agrees in principle to disband in [Algeria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algeria "Algeria").
*   [June 8](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_8 "June 8") – The government of [Colombia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colombia "Colombia") announces it will include the estimated value of the country's [illegal drug](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Illegal_drug_trade_in_Colombia "Illegal drug trade in Colombia") crops, exceeding half a billion US dollars, in its [gross national product](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gross_national_product "Gross national product").
*   [June 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_9 "June 9") – [Kosovo War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo_War "Kosovo War"): [Yugoslavia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serbia_and_Montenegro "Serbia and Montenegro") and [NATO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO "NATO") sign a [peace treaty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peace_treaty "Peace treaty") to end their hostilities.
*   [June 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_10 "June 10") – Kosovo War: [NATO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO "NATO") suspends its [airstrikes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Airstrike "Airstrike") after [Slobodan Milošević](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slobodan_Milo%C5%A1evi%C4%87 "Slobodan Milošević") agrees to withdraw [Yugoslav](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serbia_and_Montenegro "Serbia and Montenegro")[forces](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Armed_Forces_of_Serbia_and_Montenegro "Armed Forces of Serbia and Montenegro") from [Kosovo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autonomous_Province_of_Kosovo_and_Metohija "Autonomous Province of Kosovo and Metohija").
*   [June 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_12 "June 12") – Kosovo War: [Operation Joint Guardian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_Joint_Guardian "Operation Joint Guardian")/_Operation Agricola_ begins: [NATO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO "NATO")-led [United Nations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations "United Nations") peacekeeping forces [KFOR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kosovo_Force "Kosovo Force") enter [Kosovo, Yugoslavia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autonomous_Province_of_Kosovo_and_Metohija "Autonomous Province of Kosovo and Metohija").[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-auto-18)[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-19)[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-20)
*   [June 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_16 "June 16") – [Thabo Mbeki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thabo_Mbeki "Thabo Mbeki") is inaugurated as the second [president of South Africa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_South_Africa "President of South Africa"), marking the first [peaceful transfer of executive power](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peaceful_transition_of_power "Peaceful transition of power") in the country's post-democratization history.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-21)[_[importance?](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:What\_Wikipedia\_is\_not#Encyclopedic\_content "Wikipedia:What Wikipedia is not")_]
*   [June 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_18 "June 18") – The [J18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anti-globalization#J18 "Anti-globalization") international anti-globalization protests are organized in dozens of cities around the world, some of which led to riots.
*   [June 19](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_19 "June 19") – [Turin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turin "Turin"), Italy, is awarded the [2006 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2006_Winter_Olympics "2006 Winter Olympics").
*   [June 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_20 "June 20") – [Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia "Australia") defeats [Pakistan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan") by 8 wickets at [Lord's Cricket Ground](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lord's_Cricket_Ground "Lord's Cricket Ground") in [London](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/London "London") in the [1999 Cricket World Cup Final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Cricket_World_Cup_Final "1999 Cricket World Cup Final"), securing their second World Cup title.
*   [June 24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_24 "June 24") – Kosovo War: NATO marines shoot three gunmen in [Kosovo, Yugoslavia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autonomous_Province_of_Kosovo_and_Metohija "Autonomous Province of Kosovo and Metohija") after being attacked by the latter, killing one of them and injuring the other two.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-auto-18)[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-22)
*   [June 25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_25 "June 25") – [Bosnia and Herzegovina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosnia_and_Herzegovina "Bosnia and Herzegovina") gets a [new national anthem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_anthem_of_Bosnia_and_Herzegovina "National anthem of Bosnia and Herzegovina").[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-23)
*   [June 30](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_30 "June 30") – Twenty-three people die in a fire at the [Sealand Youth Training Center](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sealand_Youth_Training_Center_Fire "Sealand Youth Training Center Fire") in South Korea.

### July

*   [July 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_1 "July 1")–[Europol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Europol "Europol") (short for European Police Office) the [European Union](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/European_Union "European Union")'s [criminal intelligence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Criminal_intelligence "Criminal intelligence") agency becomes fully operational.
*   [July 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_7 "July 7")– In Rome, [Hicham El Guerrouj](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hicham_El_Guerrouj "Hicham El Guerrouj") runs the [fastest mile ever recorded](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mile_run_world_record_progression "Mile run world record progression"), at 3:43.13.
*   [July 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_10 "July 10")– American soccer player [Brandi Chastain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brandi_Chastain "Brandi Chastain") scores the game winning penalty kick against [China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China "China") in the [final of the FIFA Women's World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_FIFA_Women's_World_Cup_Final "1999 FIFA Women's World Cup Final").
*   [July 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_11 "July 11")–[India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India "India") recaptures [Kargil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kargil_district "Kargil district"), forcing the [Pakistani](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan") army to retreat. India announces victory, ending the 2-month conflict.
*   [July 14](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_14 "July 14")– the [Big Blue crane collapse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Blue_crane_collapse "Big Blue crane collapse") happened during the construction of [Miller Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miller_Park "Miller Park"), killing three iron workers.
*   [July 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_15 "July 15")–[T-Mobile Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-Mobile_Park "T-Mobile Park") (formerly known as Safeco Field) opens for the first time.
*   [July 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_16 "July 16")–[John F. Kennedy Jr.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_F._Kennedy_Jr. "John F. Kennedy Jr.") dies in a plane crash off [Martha's Vineyard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Martha's_Vineyard "Martha's Vineyard").
*   [July 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_18 "July 18")– MLB Pitcher [David Cone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Cone "David Cone") of the [New York Yankees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_Yankees "New York Yankees"), throws the 16th [perfect game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perfect_game_(baseball) "Perfect game (baseball)") in Major League Baseball history.
*   [July 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_20 "July 20")
    *   [Mercury program](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Project_Mercury "Project Mercury"): [Liberty Bell 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercury-Redstone_4 "Mercury-Redstone 4") – piloted by [Gus Grissom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gus_Grissom "Gus Grissom") in [1961](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1961 "1961") – is raised from the Atlantic Ocean.
    *   [Falun Gong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falun_Gong "Falun Gong") is banned in the People's Republic of China under [Jiang Zemin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jiang_Zemin "Jiang Zemin").

*   [July 22](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_22 "July 22")–[25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_25 "July 25")–[Woodstock '99](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Woodstock_'99 "Woodstock '99") was held in [Rome, New York](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rome,_New_York "Rome, New York") at former [Griffiss Air Force Base](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Griffiss_Air_Force_Base "Griffiss Air Force Base"), which was marred with difficult environmental conditions, poor sanitation, overpriced food and water, looting, violence, rapes, riots and several deaths.
*   [July 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_23 "July 23")
    *   NASA's [Chandra X-ray Observatory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandra_X-ray_Observatory "Chandra X-ray Observatory") is launched.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-24)
    *   [Mohammed VI of Morocco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohammed_VI_of_Morocco "Mohammed VI of Morocco") becomes king upon the death of his father [Hassan II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hassan_II_of_Morocco "Hassan II of Morocco").
    *   Fourteen [Kosovar Serb](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serbs "Serbs") villagers are [killed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Staro_Gracko_massacre "Staro Gracko massacre") by ethnic Albanian gunmen in the village of Staro Gračko.

*   [July 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_27 "July 27")– Twenty-one people die in a [canyoning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canyoning "Canyoning") disaster at the [Saxetenbach Gorge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saxetenbach_Gorge "Saxetenbach Gorge") near [Interlaken](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interlaken "Interlaken"), Switzerland.
*   [July 31](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_31 "July 31")–[NASA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA "NASA") intentionally crashes the [Lunar Prospector](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunar_Prospector "Lunar Prospector")[spacecraft](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spacecraft "Spacecraft") into the [Moon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon "Moon"), thus ending its mission to detect frozen water on the lunar surface.

### August

*   [August 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_7 "August 7")– Dagestan incursions: Hundreds of Chechen guerrillas invade the Russian republic of [Dagestan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dagestan "Dagestan"), triggering the [short war](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/War_in_Dagestan_(1999) "War in Dagestan (1999)").[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-25)
*   [August 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_10 "August 10")– The [Atlantique incident](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Pakistan_Breguet_1150_Atlantic_shootdown "1999 Pakistan Breguet 1150 Atlantic shootdown") occurs as an intruding [Pakistan Navy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan_Navy "Pakistan Navy") plane is shot down in India, sparking tensions between the two nations, a month after the end of the [Kargil War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kargil_War "Kargil War").[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-26)
*   [August 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_11 "August 11")– A [total solar eclipse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_August_11,_1999 "Solar eclipse of August 11, 1999") is seen in Europe and Asia.
*   [August 17](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_17 "August 17")– The 7.6 M w[İzmit earthquake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_%C4%B0zmit_earthquake "1999 İzmit earthquake") shakes northwestern [Turkey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkey "Turkey") with a maximum [Mercalli intensity](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercalli_intensity_scale "Mercalli intensity scale") of IX (_Violent_), leaving more than 17,000 dead and around 50,000 injured.
*   [August 19](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_19 "August 19")– In [Belgrade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgrade "Belgrade"), tens of thousands of [Yugoslavs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serbia_and_Montenegro "Serbia and Montenegro") rally to demand the resignation of [Yugoslav President](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Serbia_and_Montenegro "President of Serbia and Montenegro")[Slobodan Milošević](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slobodan_Milo%C5%A1evi%C4%87 "Slobodan Milošević").
*   [August 26](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_26 "August 26")–[WWE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WWE "WWE") introduce their secondary program, _[SmackDown](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SmackDown "SmackDown")_, which started its broadcast on [UPN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UPN "UPN").
*   [August 30](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_30 "August 30")–[East Timor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/East_Timor "East Timor") votes for independence from [Indonesia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indonesia "Indonesia") (which had invaded and occupied it since 1975) in [a referendum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_East_Timorese_independence_referendum "1999 East Timorese independence referendum").

### September

*   [September 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_3 "September 3")– The [1999 Ontario Highway 401 crash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Ontario_Highway_401_crash "1999 Ontario Highway 401 crash") occurs, involving 87 vehicles and killing 8.
*   [September 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_7 "September 7")– The 6.0 M w[Athens earthquake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Athens_earthquake "1999 Athens earthquake") hits with a maximum [Mercalli intensity](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercalli_intensity_scale "Mercalli intensity scale") of IX (_Violent_), killing 143, injuring 800–1,600, and leaving 50,000 homeless.
*   [September 8](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_8 "September 8")– The first of a series of [Russian apartment bombings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Russian_apartment_bombings "1999 Russian apartment bombings") occurs. Subsequent bombings occur on September 13 and 16, while a bombing on September 22 fails.
*   [September 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_9 "September 9")–[Sega](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sega "Sega") releases the [Dreamcast](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dreamcast "Dreamcast") in North America, marking the launch of its final home [video game console](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_game_console "Video game console").[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-27)
*   [September 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_12 "September 12")– Under international pressure to allow an international peacekeeping force, Indonesian president BJ Habibie announces that he will do so.
*   [September 14](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_14 "September 14")–[Kiribati](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiribati "Kiribati"), [Nauru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nauru "Nauru") and [Tonga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tonga "Tonga") join the [United Nations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations "United Nations").
*   [September 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_20 "September 20")– Start of the [1999 Greek stock market crash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Greek_stock_market_crash "1999 Greek stock market crash").
*   [September 21](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_21 "September 21")– The 7.7 M w[921 earthquake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Jiji_earthquake "1999 Jiji earthquake") (also known as the Jiji earthquake) affects central Taiwan with a maximum Mercali intensity of X (_Extreme_) leaving 2,400 people dead and more than 11,000 injured.
*   [September 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_23 "September 23")–[NASA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA "NASA") permanently loses contact with the _[Mars Climate Orbiter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mars\_Climate\_Orbiter "Mars Climate Orbiter")_ during [orbital insertion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orbit_insertion "Orbit insertion") around [Mars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mars "Mars"), resulting in the spacecraft's loss and the failure of the mission.

### October

*   [October 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_1 "October 1")–[Shanghai Pudong International Airport](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanghai_Pudong_International_Airport "Shanghai Pudong International Airport") opens in China, becoming the primary international airport serving [Shanghai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanghai "Shanghai") and taking over all international flights from [Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanghai_Hongqiao_International_Airport "Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport").
*   [October 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_1 "October 1")–[November 6](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_6 "November 6") – The [1999 Rugby World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Rugby_World_Cup "1999 Rugby World Cup"), the first World Cup in the [professional era of rugby](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_rugby_union#Professionalism "History of rugby union") is held in [Wales](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wales "Wales") and is won by [Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia_national_rugby_union_team "Australia national rugby union team") who beat [France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France_national_rugby_union_team "France national rugby union team") in [the final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Rugby_World_Cup_final "1999 Rugby World Cup final").[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-28)
*   [October 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_5 "October 5")– Thirty-one people die in the [Ladbroke Grove rail crash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ladbroke_Grove_rail_crash "Ladbroke Grove rail crash"), west of London, England.
*   [October 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_12 "October 12")
    *   [Pakistani](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan") Prime Minister [Nawaz Sharif](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nawaz_Sharif "Nawaz Sharif") attempts to dismiss Army Chief General [Pervez Musharraf](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pervez_Musharraf "Pervez Musharraf"), who is out of the country. The generals lead a [coup d'état](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coup_d'%C3%A9tat "Coup d'état"), ousting Sharif's administration, and Musharraf takes control of the government.
    *   [Murder of Björn Söderberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Murder_of_Bj%C3%B6rn_S%C3%B6derberg "Murder of Björn Söderberg") in Stockholm, Sweden by neo-fascists.

*   The [Croatian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Croatia "Croatia")[cargo ship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cargo_ship "Cargo ship")[_Borak_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Borak_(ship)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Borak (ship) (page does not exist)"), sailing from [Koromačno](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koroma%C4%8Dno "Koromačno") to [Solin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solin "Solin") and transporting [cement](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement "Cement"), sank near [Sestrica Vela](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sestrica_Vela_(Obonjan)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Sestrica Vela (Obonjan) (page does not exist)") after its cargo shifted because of bad weather. Two crew members (Valter Cimera and Stjepan Španić) lost their lives, while the other three (Ante Jureško, owner and captain of the ship, his son Slavko, as well as Muhamed Čeliković) were rescued by Damir Badžim (from [Šibenik](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%A0ibenik "Šibenik")) and Slaviša Malešević ([refugee from Bosnia and Herzegovina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosnian_War "Bosnian War")).[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-29)[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-30)
*   [October 25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_25 "October 25")–[Telenovela](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telenovela "Telenovela")_[Yo soy Betty, la fea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yo\_soy\_Betty,\_la\_fea "Yo soy Betty, la fea")_ debuts on [RCN Televisión](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RCN_Televisi%C3%B3n "RCN Televisión") in [Colombia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colombia "Colombia"). It will give rise to _[Ugly Betty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ugly\_Betty "Ugly Betty")_ and at least a dozen other versions worldwide.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-31)
*   [October 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_27 "October 27")–[Armenian parliament shooting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Armenian_parliament_shooting "Armenian parliament shooting"): Gunmen open fire in [Armenia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Armenia "Armenia")'s [National Assembly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Assembly_(Armenia) "National Assembly (Armenia)") building, killing Prime Minister [Vazgen Sargsyan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vazgen_Sargsyan "Vazgen Sargsyan"), Parliament Chairman [Karen Demirchyan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karen_Demirchyan "Karen Demirchyan"), and six other members.
*   [October 29](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_29 "October 29")–[1999 Odisha cyclone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Odisha_cyclone "1999 Odisha cyclone"): A super cyclonic storm impacts Orissa, India, killing approximately 10,000 people.
*   [October 30](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_30 "October 30")–[1999 Incheon bar fire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Incheon_bar_fire?action=edit&redlink=1 "1999 Incheon bar fire (page does not exist)")[[ko](https://ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/%EC%9D%B8%ED%98%84%EB%8F%99%20%ED%98%B8%ED%94%84%EC%A7%91%20%ED%99%94%EC%9E%AC%20%EC%B0%B8%EC%82%AC "ko:인현동 호프집 화재 참사")]: A bar catches fire in [Incheon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Incheon "Incheon"), South Korea, killing 56 people.
*   [October 31](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_31 "October 31")
    *   [EgyptAir Flight 990](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/EgyptAir_Flight_990 "EgyptAir Flight 990"), travelling from New York City to [Cairo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cairo "Cairo"), crashes off the coast of [Nantucket](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nantucket "Nantucket"), Massachusetts killing all 217 on board.
    *   The [Catholic Church](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic_Church "Catholic Church") and several [Lutheran Church](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lutheran_Church "Lutheran Church") leaders sign the [Joint Declaration on the Doctrine of Justification](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joint_Declaration_on_the_Doctrine_of_Justification "Joint Declaration on the Doctrine of Justification"), attempting to resolve a centuries-old doctrinal dispute over the nature of [faith](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faith "Faith") and [salvation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salvation "Salvation").

### November

*   [November 6](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_6 "November 6")– Australians defeat a [referendum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Australian_republic_referendum "1999 Australian republic referendum") proposing the replacement of the Queen and the Governor General with a President to make Australia a republic.
*   [November 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_12 "November 12")– The 7.2 M w[Düzce earthquake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_D%C3%BCzce_earthquake "1999 Düzce earthquake") shakes northwestern [Turkey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkey "Turkey") with a maximum [Mercalli intensity](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercalli_intensity_scale "Mercalli intensity scale") of IX (_Violent_). At least 845 people are killed and almost 5,000 are injured.
*   [November 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_20 "November 20")–[China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China "China") launches the first [Shenzhou spacecraft](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shenzhou_spacecraft "Shenzhou spacecraft").
*   [November 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_23 "November 23")– The [National Assembly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Assembly_(Kuwait) "National Assembly (Kuwait)") of [Kuwait](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kuwait "Kuwait") revokes a [1985](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1985 "1985") law that granted women's suffrage.
*   [November 26](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_26 "November 26")– The 7.5 M w[Ambrym earthquake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Ambrym_earthquake "1999 Ambrym earthquake") shakes [Vanuatu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vanuatu "Vanuatu") and a destructive tsunami follows, killing 10 and injuring 40.
*   [November 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_27 "November 27")– The centre-left [Labour Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Zealand_Labour_Party "New Zealand Labour Party") takes control of the [New Zealand Government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Zealand_Government "New Zealand Government"), with leader [Helen Clark](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helen_Clark "Helen Clark") becoming the second female [Prime Minister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_New_Zealand "Prime Minister of New Zealand") in New Zealand's history.

### December

*   [December 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_3 "December 3")
    *   After rowing for 81 days and 5,486 kilometers (2,962 nautical miles), [Tori Murden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tori_Murden "Tori Murden") becomes the first woman to cross the Atlantic Ocean by [rowboat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rowboat "Rowboat") alone, when she reaches [Guadeloupe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guadeloupe "Guadeloupe") from the [Canary Islands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canary_Islands "Canary Islands").
    *   [NASA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA "NASA") loses radio contact with the [Mars Polar Lander](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mars_Polar_Lander "Mars Polar Lander"), moments before the spacecraft enters the [Martian atmosphere](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atmosphere_of_Mars "Atmosphere of Mars").

*   [December 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_5 "December 5")–[Bolivian municipal elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Bolivian_municipal_elections "1999 Bolivian municipal elections"), the first election contested by [Evo Morales](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evo_Morales "Evo Morales")' [Movimiento al Socialismo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Movimiento_al_Socialismo "Movimiento al Socialismo").
*   [December 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_9 "December 9") – The hormone [Ghrelin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghrelin "Ghrelin") is discovered and named.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-32)
*   [December 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_18 "December 18")– NASA launches the Terra platform into orbit, carrying five Earth Observation instruments, including [ASTER](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advanced_Spaceborne_Thermal_Emission_and_Reflection_Radiometer "Advanced Spaceborne Thermal Emission and Reflection Radiometer"), [CERES](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clouds_and_the_Earth's_Radiant_Energy_System "Clouds and the Earth's Radiant Energy System"), [MISR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multi-angle_imaging_spectroradiometer "Multi-angle imaging spectroradiometer"), [MODIS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moderate_Resolution_Imaging_Spectroradiometer "Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer") and [MOPITT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MOPITT "MOPITT").
*   [December 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_20 "December 20")–[Handover of Macau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Handover_of_Macau "Handover of Macau"): the [Portuguese Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portuguese_Republic "Portuguese Republic") transfers administration of [Macau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macau "Macau") to the People's Republic of China after 442 years of Portuguese rule in the settlement.
*   [December 24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_24 "December 24")–[Indian Airlines Flight 814](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Airlines_Flight_814 "Indian Airlines Flight 814") was hijacked on 24 December 1999 by five members of [Harkat-ul-Mujahideen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harkat-ul-Mujahideen "Harkat-ul-Mujahideen") in what was considered to be India's worst and last plane hijacking
*   [December 26](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_26 "December 26")–[Cyclone Lothar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclone_Lothar "Cyclone Lothar") kills 140 people as it crosses France, southern Germany, and Switzerland.
*   [December 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_27 "December 27")– A day after Cyclone Lothar, [Cyclone Martin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclone_Martin_(1999) "Cyclone Martin (1999)") causes additional damage throughout France, Spain, Switzerland and Italy, including an emergency due to [flooding at the Blayais Nuclear Power Plant](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Blayais_Nuclear_Power_Plant_flood "1999 Blayais Nuclear Power Plant flood").
*   [December 31](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_31 "December 31")
    *   [Boris Yeltsin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boris_Yeltsin "Boris Yeltsin") resigns as [President of Russia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Russia "President of Russia"), leaving [Prime Minister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Russia "Prime Minister of Russia")[Vladimir Putin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vladimir_Putin "Vladimir Putin") as the acting president until a new [election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2000_Russian_presidential_election "2000 Russian presidential election") can be held.
    *   With the [Torrijos–Carter Treaties](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torrijos%E2%80%93Carter_Treaties "Torrijos–Carter Treaties") being put into effect on this day, [Panama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Panama "Panama") gains full control of the [Canal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Panama_Canal "Panama Canal").
    *   [Millennium celebrations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Millennium_celebrations "Millennium celebrations"): A series of worldwide celebrations mark the end of 1999 and the beginning of the year [2000](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2000 "2000"), popularly regarded as the start of the [21st century](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/21st_century "21st century") and the [3rd millennium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/3rd_millennium "3rd millennium"), with fireworks displays, concerts, and public festivities held across the globe.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_1999#cite_note-33)

**Kiernan Brennan Shipka** (born November 10, 1999)[[1]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-1)[[2]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-chicago_tribune-2) is an American actress. She is best known for her roles as [Sally Draper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Mad_Men_characters#Sally_Draper "List of Mad Men characters") in the [AMC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AMC_(TV_channel) "AMC (TV channel)") drama series _[Mad Men](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mad\_Men "Mad Men")_ (2007–2015), and [Sabrina Spellman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabrina_Spellman "Sabrina Spellman") in the [Netflix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netflix "Netflix") fantasy series _[Chilling Adventures of Sabrina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chilling\_Adventures\_of\_Sabrina\_(TV\_series) "Chilling Adventures of Sabrina (TV series)")_ (2018–2020) and the sixth season of [The CW](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_CW "The CW") series _[Riverdale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riverdale\_(American\_TV\_series) "Riverdale (American TV series)")_ (2021–2022).[[3]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-deadline-3)

In addition to supporting roles in films such as _[Longlegs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Longlegs "Longlegs")_, _[Twisters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twisters\_(film) "Twisters (film)")_, and _[The Last Showgirl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Last\_Showgirl "The Last Showgirl")_ (all in 2024), Shipka has also had starring roles in _[The Blackcoat's Daughter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Blackcoat's\_Daughter "The Blackcoat's Daughter")_ (2015), _[Totally Killer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Totally\_Killer "Totally Killer")_ (2023), and _[Sweethearts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sweethearts\_(2024\_film) "Sweethearts (2024 film)")_ (2024), among others.

## Early life

[[edit](http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kiernan_Shipka&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life")]

Kiernan Brennan Shipka was born on November 10, 1999, in [Chicago](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago "Chicago"), Illinois, to John Young Shipka, a real-estate developer, and Erin Ann Brennan.[[4]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-MadTween-4)[[5]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-Kiddieland-5)[[6]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-6) She is of mostly Irish and Slovak descent.[[7]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-7) She also has notable German, English, Scottish, and Italian heritage. Shipka started taking [ballroom dancing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ballroom_dancing "Ballroom dancing") classes at the age of five and was still attending classes as of March 2012.[[8]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-8) When she was six, her family relocated to [Los Angeles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles "Los Angeles") to help with her acting career.[[5]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-Kiddieland-5)

## Career

[[edit](http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kiernan_Shipka&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]

### 2000–2017: Beginnings and _Mad Men_

[[edit](http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kiernan_Shipka&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: 2000–2017: Beginnings and Mad Men")]

[![Image 5](http://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0a/Kiernan_Shipka_%28cropped_2%29.jpg/250px-Kiernan_Shipka_%28cropped_2%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Kiernan_Shipka_(cropped_2).jpg)

Shipka at the 2010 [Screen Actors Guild Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screen_Actors_Guild_Awards "Screen Actors Guild Awards")

In April 2000, Shipka made her television debut at five months of age on the hospital drama _[ER](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ER\_(TV\_series) "ER (TV series)")_.[[9]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-dazeddigital-9) She started commercial-print modeling when she was a baby.[[4]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-MadTween-4) After undertaking small television roles, her first major role was as [Sally Draper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Mad_Men_characters#Sally_Draper "List of Mad Men characters"), the daughter of main character [Don Draper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don_Draper "Don Draper"), on the 2007–2015 TV series _[Mad Men](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mad\_Men "Mad Men")_. She won the role after two auditions.[[10]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-NYT032615-10) She was a recurring guest star for the show's first three seasons, then became a series regular in [season four](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mad_Men_(season_4) "Mad Men (season 4)").[[5]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-Kiddieland-5)

As part of _Mad Men_'s ensemble cast, she won the [Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screen_Actors_Guild_Award_for_Outstanding_Performance_by_an_Ensemble_in_a_Drama_Series "Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series") in 2008 and 2009.[[11]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-11) Shipka received praise for her performance on _Mad Men_. In 2010, _[Austin American-Statesman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Austin\_American-Statesman "Austin American-Statesman")_ critic Dale Roe named her as his dream nominee for the [Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Primetime_Emmy_Award_for_Outstanding_Guest_Actress_in_a_Drama_Series "Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series"), writing, "This 10-year-old actress was so affecting as troubled Sally Draper last season that it seems odd that she's only just been upgraded to series regular. If Shipka's upcoming _Mad Men_ work—struggling with the broken marriage of her parents and entering preteendom in the tumultuous 1960s—remains as amazing as it was in [season three](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mad_Men_(season_3) "Mad Men (season 3)"), this is a ballot wish that could come true next year."[[12]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-roe-12)

Beginning in 2012, Shipka voiced [Jinora](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender_characters#Jinora "List of Avatar: The Last Airbender characters") in the [Nickelodeon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nickelodeon "Nickelodeon") animated series _[The Legend of Korra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Legend\_of\_Korra "The Legend of Korra")_, the sequel to _[Avatar: The Last Airbender](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:\_The\_Last\_Airbender "Avatar: The Last Airbender")_.[[13]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-castinitial-13) In 2014, Shipka was named one of "The 25 Most Influential Teens of 2014" by [_Time_ magazine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_Magazine "Time Magazine").[[14]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-14) That same year, [IndieWire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IndieWire "IndieWire") included her in their list of "20 Actors To Watch That Are Under 20".[[15]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-15) She starred in the 2014 [Lifetime](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lifetime_(TV_network) "Lifetime (TV network)") movie _[Flowers in the Attic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flowers\_in\_the\_Attic\_(2014\_film) "Flowers in the Attic (2014 film)")_, based on the [1979 novel of the same name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flowers_in_the_Attic "Flowers in the Attic") by [V. C. Andrews](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/V._C._Andrews "V. C. Andrews").[[16]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-16) The following year she co-starred with [Emma Roberts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Roberts "Emma Roberts") in the [Osgood Perkins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oz_Perkins "Oz Perkins") horror film _[The Blackcoat's Daughter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Blackcoat's\_Daughter "The Blackcoat's Daughter")_, and with [Timothée Chalamet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timoth%C3%A9e_Chalamet "Timothée Chalamet") in the fantasy thriller _[One & Two](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/One\_&\_Two "One & Two")_.[[17]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-17)[[18]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-18) Additionally, she voiced the title character in the English dub of [Studio Ghibli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Studio_Ghibli "Studio Ghibli")'s _[When Marnie Was There](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/When\_Marnie\_Was\_There\_(film) "When Marnie Was There (film)")_.[[19]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-19) In 2017, Shipka portrayed [B.D. Hyman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B.D._Hyman "B.D. Hyman"), daughter of [Bette Davis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bette_Davis "Bette Davis"), in the [FX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FX_(TV_channel) "FX (TV channel)") television series _[Feud: Bette and Joan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Feud\_(American\_TV\_series) "Feud (American TV series)")_.

### 2018–2021: _Chilling Adventures of Sabrina_

[[edit](http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kiernan_Shipka&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: 2018–2021: Chilling Adventures of Sabrina")]

[![Image 6](http://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/25/Kiernan_Shipka_in_2018_-_1.png/250px-Kiernan_Shipka_in_2018_-_1.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Kiernan_Shipka_in_2018_-_1.png)

Shipka in 2018.

In January 2018, Shipka was announced to be starring as [Sabrina Spellman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabrina_Spellman "Sabrina Spellman") in [Netflix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netflix "Netflix")'s _[Chilling Adventures of Sabrina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chilling\_Adventures\_of\_Sabrina\_(TV\_series) "Chilling Adventures of Sabrina (TV series)")_ series based on the [comic series of the same name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chilling_Adventures_of_Sabrina "Chilling Adventures of Sabrina").[[3]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-deadline-3) The first part was released by Netflix on October 26, 2018,[[20]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-20) and an episode that December. The show ran for three more parts, concluding on December 31, 2020, with a total of 36 episodes.[[21]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-21) Shipka reprised the role in two episodes of _[Riverdale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riverdale\_(American\_TV\_series) "Riverdale (American TV series)")_, "Chapter Ninety-Nine: The Witching Hour(s)" and "Chapter One Hundred and Fourteen: The Witches of Riverdale", which aired on December 7, 2021, and July 10, 2022, respectively.[[22]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-22)[[23]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-23)

Shipka played a deaf teenager opposite [Stanley Tucci](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanley_Tucci "Stanley Tucci") in [John R. Leonetti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_R._Leonetti "John R. Leonetti")'s [horror film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horror_film "Horror film")_[The Silence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Silence\_(2019\_film) "The Silence (2019 film)")_, based on the 2015 novel of the same name by [Tim Lebbon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tim_Lebbon "Tim Lebbon").[[24]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-24) Netflix released the film on April 10, 2019.[[25]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-25) Shipka learned [American Sign Language](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Sign_Language "American Sign Language") for the role and Leonetti praised her performance, saying: "She's acting alongside Stanley Tucci, and believe me, she's more than holding her own. It's been spellbinding watching her."[[26]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-26) That same year, Shipka co-starred in the [Christmas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christmas_film "Christmas film")[romantic comedy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romantic_comedy "Romantic comedy") film _[Let It Snow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Let\_It\_Snow\_(2019\_film) "Let It Snow (2019 film)")_, based on the novel _[Let It Snow: Three Holiday Romances](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Let\_It\_Snow:\_Three\_Holiday\_Romances "Let It Snow: Three Holiday Romances")_.[[27]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-27)

In 2022, Shipka starred alongside [Diane Kruger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diane_Kruger "Diane Kruger") in the psychological drama series _[Swimming with Sharks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swimming\_with\_Sharks\_(TV\_series) "Swimming with Sharks (TV series)")_, inspired by the [1994 film of the same name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swimming_with_Sharks "Swimming with Sharks").[[28]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-28) She also played Bea Johnson, the daughter of two intellectually disabled parents, in the drama _[Wildflower](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wildflower\_(2022\_film) "Wildflower (2022 film)")_.[[29]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-29)[[30]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-30) The following year she appeared in the [HBO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HBO "HBO") political drama limited series [_White House Plumbers_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_House_Plumbers_(miniseries) "White House Plumbers (miniseries)"), portraying Kevan Hunt, daughter of [E. Howard Hunt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E._Howard_Hunt "E. Howard Hunt").[[31]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-31) In October 2023, Shipka starred alongside actress [Olivia Holt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olivia_Holt "Olivia Holt") in [Amazon Prime Video](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Prime_Video "Amazon Prime Video")'s 1980s horror-comedy _[Totally Killer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Totally\_Killer "Totally Killer")_.[[32]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-Hollywood_Reporter-32)

In July 2024, Shipka appeared in the horror thriller _[Longlegs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Longlegs "Longlegs")_, reuniting her with _The Blackcoat's Daughter_ director Osgood Perkins.[[33]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-33) Later that year, she had supporting roles in the films _[Twisters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twisters\_(film) "Twisters (film)")_, _[The Last Showgirl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Last\_Showgirl "The Last Showgirl")_ and _[Red One](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red\_One\_(film) "Red One (film)")_.[[34]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-34)[[35]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-35)[[36]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-36) In addition, she co-starred alongside [Nico Hiraga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nico_Hiraga "Nico Hiraga") in the [Max](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_(streaming_service) "Max (streaming service)") romantic comedy _[Sweethearts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sweethearts\_(2024\_film) "Sweethearts (2024 film)")_,[[37]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-37) and in the thriller film _[Stone Cold Fox](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stone\_Cold\_Fox "Stone Cold Fox")_, which premiered in November 2025.[[38]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-38)

In 2026, she appeared in the fourth season of the HBO/[BBC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BBC "BBC") drama _[Industry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industry\_(TV\_series) "Industry (TV series)")_.[[39]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-Shipka,_Farthing,_Jimoh,_and_James-Kelly-39) She also starred in the comedy film _[Idiots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idiots\_(2026\_film) "Idiots (2026 film)")_, which premiered at the [2026 Sundance Film Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Sundance_Film_Festival "2026 Sundance Film Festival").[[40]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-40)[[41]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-41)

She is set to star alongside [Cole Sprouse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cole_Sprouse "Cole Sprouse") in the romantic comedy _[Goodbye Girl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goodbye\_Girl\_(film) "Goodbye Girl (film)")_,[[42]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-42) as well as _The Nowhere Game_, which will reunite her with [Mckenna Grace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mckenna_Grace "Mckenna Grace"), who portrayed the younger version of her character in _Chilling Adventures of Sabrina_.[[43]](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiernan_Shipka#cite_note-43)
